ar.advice_dont_click: لا تضغط على الروابط ولا ترد على الرسالة.
ar.advice_verify_official: تأكد بنفسك عبر الرقم أو التطبيق الرسمي للجهة، مو عبر الرقم اللي بالرسالة.
ar.advice_never_share_otp: لا تشارك رمز التحقق (OTP) أو الرقم السري مع أي أحد، حتى لو قال إنه من البنك أو الشرطة.
ar.advice_report: بلّغ عنها في صقر عشان تحمي غيرك.

ar.report_sub: بلاغك يحمي غيرك. ما نطلب اسمك ولا رقمك، ونحذف بياناتك الشخصية من النص تلقائياً.
ar.report_ok_d: سيظهر في السجل بعد مراجعة الجهات المختصة أو بعد تكرار البلاغ من أكثر من شخص.
ar.report_redacted: حذفنا بيانات شخصية من النص قبل الحفظ (مثل رقم بطاقة أو هوية أو رمز).
ar.privacy_1: بدون حساب، بدون اسم، بدون رقم هاتفك.
ar.privacy_2: نحذف تلقائياً أرقام البطاقات والهوية والآيبان والإيميل والرموز من النص.
ar.privacy_3: نحفظ بصمة مشفّرة تتغيّر يومياً فقط لمنع التكرار، ولا يمكن ربطها بك.
ar.registry_sub: روابط وأرقام ورسائل وثّقتها الجهات المختصة أو بلّغ عنها أكثر من شخص.
ar.no_results: ما فيه نتائج. هذا لا يعني إنه آمن، افحصه أولاً.
ar.tip1_d: لا الشرطة ولا البنك ولا أي جهة حكومية تطلب منك رمز التحقق أو الرقم السري. أي طلب لهم = احتيال.
ar.tip2_d: إذا وصلك رابط لدفع مخالفة، افتح التطبيق الرسمي بنفسك وتأكد. لا تدفع من رابط رسالة.
ar.tip3_d: المواقع الحكومية تنتهي بـ gov.ae. انتبه للمواقع المقلدة مثل gov-ae أو أسماء جهات على نطاقات غريبة.
ar.tip4_d: "خلال 24 ساعة" و"سيتم إيقاف حسابك" أساليب ضغط عشان ما تفكر.
ar.tip5_d: قبل ما تحوّل لأي أحد يقول إنه قريبك برقم جديد، اتصل على رقمه القديم أو اسأل العائلة.
ar.tip6_d: اتصل بالبنك فوراً لإيقاف البطاقة، غيّر كلمات المرور، وتواصل مع الشرطة (999 في الطوارئ)، وبلّغ في صقر.
ar.footer: صقر، نموذج أولي لمسابقة الابتكار في مكافحة الجريمة الإلكترونية. البيانات المعروضة تجريبية.

ar.a1: لا. صقر نموذج أولي لمسابقة ابتكار، ويكمّل قنوات الشرطة الرسمية ولا يغني عنها. في الطوارئ اتصل على 999.
ar.a2: لا. الفحص يتم على خوادم صقر ونحفظ عدّاد يومي فقط (اليوم، النوع، الحكم) بدون النص أو الرابط.
ar.q3: كيف يعرف صقر إن الرسالة احتيال؟
ar.a3: ثلاث طبقات: نموذج تعلّم آلي مدرّب على رسائل عربية وإنجليزية، وقواعد تكشف أساليب الاحتيال، وفحص كل رابط ورقم داخل الرسالة مع السجل المجتمعي.
ar.a4: يدخل البلاغ قائمة المراجعة عند الجهات المختصة. إذا توثّق، يصير أي أحد يفحص نفس الرقم أو الرابط يشوفه خطير، ويدخل قائمة الحظر.
ar.q5: دفعت أو عطيت الرمز، وش أسوي؟
ar.a5: اتصل بالبنك فوراً عبر الرقم اللي خلف بطاقتك لإيقافها، غيّر كلمات المرور، وتواصل مع الشرطة، وبلّغ في صقر.
ar.q6: من يشوف أدلة الابتزاز اللي أرفعها؟
ar.a6: تتشفّر فور وصولها، ولا يفتحها إلا المراجع المخوّل، وكل فتح ينسجل. وتقدر تسحب البلاغ ويُحذف كل شي.

en.advice_stay_alert: Stay alert: any request for a verification code or PIN is fraud, even if it looks official.
en.advice_official_channels: Deal with organisations only through their official apps and websites.
en.advice_dont_click: Do not click links or reply to the message.
en.advice_verify_official: Verify yourself via the organisation’s official number or app, not the one in the message.
en.advice_never_share_otp: Never share your OTP or PIN with anyone, even if they say they are the bank or police.
en.advice_report: Report it on Saqr to protect others.
en.advice_block: Block the sender and delete the message after reporting.
en.advice_if_paid: If you paid or shared data: call your bank immediately via the number on your card to block it, and contact the police.
en.report_sub: Your report protects others. We do not ask for your name or number, and we automatically remove personal data from the text.
en.report_ok_d: It will appear in the registry after review by the authorities, or once several people report it.
en.report_redacted: We removed personal data from the text before saving (such as a card, ID or code).
en.privacy_1: No account, no name, no phone number of yours.
en.privacy_2: Card numbers, Emirates ID, IBAN, emails and codes are removed from the text automatically.
en.privacy_3: We keep only a daily-rotating encrypted fingerprint to stop duplicates; it cannot be linked to you.
en.registry_sub: Links, numbers and messages verified by the authorities or reported by several people.
en.no_results: No results. That does not mean it is safe, scan it first.
en.tip1_d: Neither the police, your bank nor any government body will ask for your OTP or PIN. Any such request is fraud.
en.tip2_t: Pay fines in the official app
en.tip2_d: Got a link to pay a fine? Open the official app yourself and check. Never pay from a message link.
en.tip3_t: Check the domain before you click
en.tip3_d: Government sites end with gov.ae. Watch for fakes like gov-ae or authority names on strange domains.
en.tip4_d: “Within 24 hours” and “your account will be suspended” are pressure tactics so you don’t think.
en.tip5_t: Relative on a new number? Call them
en.tip5_d: Before sending money to someone claiming to be family on a new number, call their old number or ask the family.
en.tip6_d: Call your bank immediately to block the card, change your passwords, contact the police (999 in emergencies) and report on Saqr.

en.help_title: Being blackmailed? You are not alone
en.help_sub: Extortion is a crime and the blame is on the extorter, not you. Follow these steps, and open an anonymous confidential report if you want.
en.hs1_d: Paying does not stop an extorter, it usually makes them ask for more.
en.hs2_d: Screenshot everything: the account, messages, threats and any account or wallet number they gave.
en.hs3_d: After saving evidence, don’t reply or negotiate. Block and report their account on the platform.
en.hs4_d: Contact the police (999 in emergencies), or open a confidential report here and track it with your own number and code.
en.f_demand: What is the extorter asking for?
en.f_paid: Have you paid or sent anything?
en.f_case_desc: What happened? (don’t include your name or personal details)
en.f_contact_hint: Leave empty if you don’t want to be contacted. You can track the report with its number and code.
en.f_files: Evidence: screenshots or PDF (up to 5 files, 5MB each)
en.files_note: Files are encrypted on arrival, and each gets a SHA-256 fingerprint proving it was not altered.
en.case_ok_d: Save the report number and code somewhere safe. We cannot recover the code, we only store it hashed.
en.withdraw: Withdraw report and delete all its data
en.withdraw_confirm: Click again to confirm, deletion is permanent
en.withdrawn: The report and all evidence were permanently deleted.
en.e_description_short: Write a short description (at least 10 characters).
en.e_file_type: We accept images (PNG, JPG, WEBP, GIF) and PDF only.

en.badge_guard_d: Sharp eye, you’re close to Falcon level.
en.badge_falcon_d: Nothing gets past you! Share the challenge with your family.

en.fam_sub: Link your parent’s phone to Saqr. If they scan a suspicious message or tap “I need help”, you get an alert here.
en.fam_pair_d: Or scan the code with their phone camera. The simplified page will then be ready for them.
en.fam_privacy: Privacy: you only receive the verdict and fraud type. The message text reaches you only if your relative chooses to share it.

en.eld_unpaired: Not linked with family, ask your son or daughter to send you the protection link.
en.eld_share: Send the message text to my family
en.eld_help: I need help, alert my family
en.eld_safe: Looks safe. But never give anyone a code or PIN.
en.eld_suspicious: Careful! It has scam signs. Don’t tap any link, ask one of your children.
en.eld_dangerous: This is a scam! Don’t tap, don’t reply, and don’t give any number or code.
en.radar_sub: Reports linked by the same links, numbers or message template = one campaign.
en.case_note_ph: Message shown to the victim when they track the report…
en.how1_d: Paste the message, link or number. Saqr gives the verdict and its reasons in a second.
en.how2_d: No name. We remove your data from the text and keep the scammer’s number and link as evidence.
en.how3_d: The authorities verify the indicator, so everyone who checks it sees it, and it joins block lists.
en.demo_sms: Unpaid fine AED 400. Pay within 24 hours: adpolice-fines.com
en.sc_fake_fine: A “fine” with a payment link and a 24-hour clock. Real fines are paid only in the official app.
en.sc_bank_otp: A call or text from “the bank” asking for the code. Banks never ask for your OTP.
en.sc_parcel: A parcel “on hold” and a tiny fee. The small fee is bait for your card details.
en.sc_impersonation: A “mandatory” ID update on a domain imitating gov.ae.
en.sc_prize: A prize for a draw you never entered, and a fee before you can collect.
en.sc_investment: Guaranteed profit in a week. No investment is risk-free.
en.sc_job: Daily pay for likes, then a visa fee or “paid tasks”.
en.sc_family_emergency: A relative on a new number who needs money now. Call their old number first.
en.sc_shopping: Unreal discounts in a shop a few days old, bank transfer only.
en.w1_d: We read the link as text, so your device and activity stay unexposed.
en.w2_d: Only a daily counter, never the text.
en.w3_d: MSA, Gulf Arabic and English, with spelling normalised.
en.w4_d: Every verdict shows its reasons and the words behind it.
en.w5_d: No name, no number. A daily fingerprint only stops duplicates.
en.w6_d: Cards, IDs, IBANs and codes are stripped from reports.
en.w7_d: Unverified entries appear masked, after three reports.
en.w8_d: Children get an alert if a parent scans something dangerous.
en.w9_d: Encrypted evidence with a fingerprint that proves it is unaltered.
en.a1: No. Saqr is a prototype for an innovation competition. It complements official police channels and does not replace them. In an emergency call 999.
en.q2: Do you keep what I scan?
en.a2: No. Scans run on Saqr’s servers and we keep only a daily counter (day, type, verdict), never the text or link.
en.q3: How does Saqr know a message is a scam?
en.a3: Three layers: a machine-learning model trained on Arabic and English messages, rules for known fraud tactics, and a check of every link and number inside the message against the community registry.
en.a4: The report joins the authorities’ review queue. Once verified, anyone who checks the same number or link sees it as dangerous, and it joins the block list.
en.q5: I paid or shared the code. What now?
en.a5: Call your bank immediately via the number on your card to block it, change your passwords, contact the police and report on Saqr.
en.q6: Who sees the extortion evidence I upload?
en.a6: It is encrypted on arrival, only an authorised reviewer can open it, and every opening is logged. You can withdraw the report and everything is deleted.
